requirements.title: An INTRINSIC statement specifies the INTRINSIC attribute for listed names
requirements.definition: An INTRINSIC statement specifies the INTRINSIC attribute for a list of names.

requirements.title: Each INTRINSIC statement name is an intrinsic procedure name
requirements.definition: Every intrinsic-procedure-name in an INTRINSIC statement must be the name of an intrinsic procedure.
